sentence: This project builds a computer tool that learns from data to help doctors make decisions about shock and other critical care conditions.
This project studies how telehealth use affects access to cancer care and the quality of care for veterans with lung, colorectal, prostate and breast cancers.
This project builds an imaging method that uses a dye to make tumors brighter so surgeons can find and remove oral cancer while saving speech.
This project develops a virus therapy that replaces a faulty heart gene with its normal version and tests it in mouse models.
This project tests an imaging method that uses light and sound, with gold nanoparticles, to find signs that predict how eye disease responds to treatment.
This project studies how proteins move cholesterol between different membranes in cells and looks for other proteins that work with them.
This project builds a cell therapy that combines natural killer cells with antibody-drug conjugates to make a ready-made treatment for many diseases.
This project tests whether MRI markers found with deep learning can help decide how to treat prostate cancer that has not spread.
This project studies how cells fuse during fertilization in an alga, focusing on how a fusion protein is controlled.
This project studies how protein layers that form around nanoparticles help them reach deep into tumors and deliver drugs to cancer cells.
This project uses mass spectrometry and computer methods to find protein complexes, see how they change in cell types, and model them in three dimensions.
This project studies large changes in the genetic material of brain tumors called gliomas and how they switch on genes and help the disease progress.
This project supports a meeting where scientists who study the testis share their latest data and technologies.
This project follows people of different ages to learn what leads to heavy smartphone and social media use and how it relates to brain development.
This project tests a gene therapy for a rare group of muscular dystrophy patients that uses a related protein to avoid harmful immune responses.
This project tests whether sugar-modified proteins in the urine of lupus nephritis patients can show how the kidney disease changes and how treatment works.
This project studies how a compound that blocks the spread of cancer works and builds more specific anti-cancer drugs from it.
This project studies why some people with a disease-causing gene mutation get symptoms while others do not.
This project designs molecules that break down a protein called MENIN to overcome drug resistance in acute leukemias.
This project uses deep learning to detect chromosomal changes so that people exposed to radiation can be sorted quickly by dose.
